title: What day are most jobs posted: posting day and hour of open jobs on company job boards
source: The job index of ATS Jobs Search (Apify Actor scaleturn/ats-jobs-search), built 2026-11-19T04:03:40.394Z: 23287 company job boards on six applicant tracking systems.

method.window: Jobs whose posting date, on the group's clock, falls from Monday 2026-10-19 to Sunday 2026-11-15: four full weeks, so every weekday is counted four times.

posting_time.workable: published_on (else created_at), a date without a time

method.date_only: Workable gives a date without a time: its jobs count for weekdays on their own date, and not for hours.
method.copies: A job with the same title, location and posting time on two or more boards of one ATS is counted once, on the board that lists it most often.
method.board_weighted: Each board's jobs in the group share one vote, split by weekday, so a board that posts hundreds of jobs counts as much as a board that posts one.
method.closure_adjusted: The snapshot holds only jobs still open, and older dates have lost more. The daily closure rate is fitted from how each weekday's count falls from week to week (least squares on the log of Monday-Friday daily counts, one level per weekday); each date's jobs are then weighted by exp(rate x age in days) before the weekday shares are taken. The rate also absorbs any trend in posting volume.
method.region: From the job's location text: US when it names the US, a US state (name or two-letter code after a comma) or one of 32 large US cities, and no other region; Europe when it names a European country or one of 73 large European cities (the lists are in ct-002/build_data.py), and no other region; else other or unknown.
method.clocks: UTC for all groups except: US-located jobs in US Eastern time (UTC-4 until 2026-11-01 06:00 UTC, UTC-5 after), Europe-located jobs in Central European time (UTC+2 until 2026-10-25 01:00 UTC, UTC+1 after).
method.refresh: For one refresh a day at a given UTC hour: the mean wait from a job's posting minute to the next refresh, and the share of jobs picked up within 6 hours, over every timed job of the four weeks.
